text:
samir: quick onboarding question — I took some notes during infra onboarding. where should I put them so they become part of the canonical runbooks? unsure if i should create under My Pages or add directly to the team space

marta-devex: hey Samir — thanks for asking. if they're personal learning notes, put them under My Pages first. if you think they belong in the canonical runbook, create the page and i can move/merge it into /Team Docs -> Engineering -> Infra -> Runbooks. canonical path: `/Team Docs/Engineering/Infra/Runbooks` (link: https://redwood.notion.so/eng-infra-runbooks)

samir: i tried to add directly to /Team Docs but the "New" button is greyed out for me — looks like i don't have edit permissions on that space

kelly: that usually means you have Viewer role for that workspace or that specific page is restricted. two quick options:
1) From the page you want to add to, click Share -> Request access and ping @marta-devex.
2) If you want to script it internally: ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood.tools/doc-access -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"page":"https://redwood.notion.so/eng-infra-runbooks","user":"samir"}'
```
(we'll approve via the access queue)

marta-devex: I'll grant you edit access in a sec. quick note about templates: team templates live in `/Templates/engineering` — please use "Create from template" for runbooks instead of copying big page trees. that keeps the template metadata intact

samir: thanks — is there a naming convention we should follow? i named my page "infra-setup-notes" locally

kelly: prefer: `eng-infra/YYYY-MM-DD-brief-title` for the page title (eg. `eng-infra/2026-03-23-oncall-runbook`). in Notion we keep a human-readable title (spaces ok) but prefix with the team slug in the title for discoverability. add the page property `Status: Draft` while it's early

samir: one more: if i create under My Pages, can it be moved without losing backlinks/comments?

marta-devex: yes — use the "Move to" option and pick the target page. comments and backlinks stay intact. if you want me to move it, add me to the page as a viewer and ping me here with the link

devex-bot: Access change: marta-devex granted Editor access to samir on /Team Docs/Engineering/Infra/Runbooks (approved via internal queue)

samir: awesome — copying content into a draft now, will ping for review when done :thumbsup:

(reacted with :white_check_mark: by kelly)
